title: Visual QA intent and autofix catalog
description: Prescribes exactly which instructions the run pipeline understands and which fixes it may apply. Everything outside this catalog is a finding, never a silent guess.
run_flow: explore (deterministic BFS per viewport; expectation oracle; screenshots)
checks (a11y incl. axe violations AND unverifiable contrast nodes, layout, scroll, runtime, slop, security when isolated, intent baseline)
vision (deterministic orchestrator dispatches screenshot pairs to skills: layout, readability, slop, consistency; additive-only, severity capped at medium)
intent (parse instruction -> patch fix-dir sources -> verify against live computed style)
verify (ONE fresh complete exploration proves every patch; an incomplete verify run proves nothing)

verdict_policy.vision_findings: additive only, severity capped at medium, cannot flip a verdict to FAIL
verdict_policy.verified_fix: counts only when a complete fresh exploration clears the issue

examples_de: ändere die Farbe von "Add item" auf grün
ändere die Farbe des Buttons auf #22c55e
examples_en: change the color of "Add item" to green
intents.values: named (de/en), #hex, rgb(); patched as resolved rgb()

examples_de: setze das padding von "Add item" auf 16px
setze den margin von "Add item" auf 8px

intent_targets.text: quoted string after von/of/in; patched element is the tag wrapping the first occurrence
intent_targets.tag: tag alias after des/der/dem/the: button, überschrift (h1..h3), header, text (p), link (a), liste (ul,ol)

unfulfillable_intents: high-severity finding 'Intent target not found' / 'Intent change not applied'

autofix_whitelist.action: insert <title> derived from the fix-dir name
parse foreground/background and font size from the axe failure summary, blend the foreground minimally toward black or white until WCAG 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text) is reached, patch inline color
autofix_whitelist.selector_support: #id, tag, .class, tag.class, tag#id, compound classes; combinators and attribute selectors are refused

contrast_incomplete: axe color-contrast nodes it could not measure are reported as rule color-contrast-incomplete (medium) - a measurement gap is a finding, never a pass

traces.out_dir: run_id + report.json + report.md + screenshots/ + traces/ + vision/ (raw model responses) + fixes/ + intent/ (before/after copies) + verify/
